rounds.text: Conceded: [E1], [E6], [E7], [E14], [E15], [E37], and [E38]. Despite these attractive headline metrics and valuation figures, severe structural and quality-of-earnings risks undermine the investment case [E28], [E56], [E57], [E58], [E59]. Operating cash flow is only 0.04x reported profit and constitutes a mere 5% of operating profit in March 2026, indicating that profits are far ahead of cash and pointing toward heavy accruals or receivables issues [E28], [E31]. Working capital inefficiency is glaring, with working capital days surging from 29.5 days to 113 days [E59]. Furthermore, earnings quality is compromised by the inclusion of Rs 8.17 Cr in other income [E58], alongside red flags regarding potentially low tax rates and capitalized interest costs [E56], [E57]. The company also fails to reward shareholders, offering a dividend yield of 0.00% despite reporting profits [E4], [E55]. Finally, historical trading carries extreme volatility at 63.6% alongside a catastrophic worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -96.6% [E45], [E46].
